theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) [Module.Finite ℤ R] [Module.Free ℤ R] : 1 < Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal := by
  have hp_prime : v.asIdeal.IsPrime := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.prime v
  have hp_maximal : v.asIdeal.IsMaximal := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.isMaximal v
  have h_ne_zero : v.asIdeal ≠ 0 := by contrapose! hp_maximal.2
  have h_norm_pos : 0 < Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal := by
    rw [Ideal.absNorm]
    exact (Ideal.norm_pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h_ne_zero)
  have h_norm_ge_1 : Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal ≥ 1 :=
    by rw [Ideal.absNorm]; exact Nat.zero_le_one
  have h_norm_lt_1 : ¬(Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal < 1) :=
    by intro h; rw [Ideal.absNorm] at h; exact lt_irrefl (Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal) h
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h_norm_ge_1 with (h | h)
  · exact false.elim h_norm_lt_1 h
  · exact h_norm_pos
